The leader board user flow shown in Figure 11 is illustrated in the images above. 
Before the user starts the activity, they may be presented with a series of pop-
ups. The iconography serves as a clear indicator to the user their current 
position and rank, with the use of traditional medals, bronze, silver, and gold, 
the user will intuitively understand their ranking and how the system works. 
Figure 21’s welcome page will have two variations, one that will be shown to 
new users that have never used the leader board system, that will delineate the 
activity and how it works; and the second will be shown to returning users that 
would like to compete again this week.  
If a user is promoted, then a congratulations page (Figure 22) will praise the 
student, and inform them of their new ranking; this strategic approach will 
positively reenforce good performance and enhance student engagement.
